words.trans: 前往；朝……去。（head to 与 head for 都表"朝某处去"，head for 更强调朝着某个方向/目标前进。）
examples: Tom collected Skylark from Maggot, and headed to the workshop.

words.trans: （itching to do sth）极想做某事；手痒想做；迫不及待想做。
examples: He headed to the workshop, itching to get back into the sky.

words.trans: 灰泥；熟石膏；（固定骨折的）石膏。
examples: Most of his right side was in plaster after the accident.

words.trans: 吃（人/同类）；用拆下的零件修配（另一台机器等），拆东补西。
examples: He welded together components cannibalized from half-dead machines.

words.trans: 鲁莽；不顾后果；轻率。
examples: He welded components together with a Frankenstein-like recklessness.

words.trans: 简化的、精简的、去繁就简的（拆掉多余部件）。
examples: The lawnmower was based on a stripped-down Flymo.

words.trans: 字面"被恶魔附身的、着魔的"；日常英语中常作夸张比喻，形容一个人像着了魔一样疯狂、不知疲倦、停不下来。
examples: 'It's like a demon-possessed hovercraft,' his aunt had laughed.

words.trans: 特意、费心、不怕麻烦地去做某事。字面"偏离自己原本的路"，引申为不惜绕路、额外花精力去帮忙或完成某事。
examples: She went out of her way to make her guests feel welcome.
She really went out of her way to help us.

words.trans: 发疯、失去理智；极度焦虑/担忧。drive sb out of his mind 把某人逼疯。
examples: The wait nearly drove him out of his mind.
He was going out of his mind with worry.

words.trans: 气垫船。
examples: It's like a demon-possessed hovercraft.

words.trans: 过时的、被淘汰的、废弃的。
examples: He added an obsolete mobile phone that served as a GPS receiver.

words.trans: 自主的、自治的、自动化的（自动运行）。
examples: This was the first fully autonomous lawnmower.

words.trans: n. 专利、专利权；adj. 明显的、显而易见的；v. 给……申请专利。
examples: You could patent that, Tom, make a packet.

words.trans: （英式口语）赚一大笔钱。
examples: You could patent that, Tom, make a packet.

words.trans: 大风的、狂风大作的；狂暴的、吵闹的。
examples: It was during a blustery night that Jim's boat came adrift.

words.trans: （船）缆绳松脱漂走、失控漂移。（adrift 漂浮的、随波逐流的；引申计划等失控、出问题。）
examples: Jim's vintage char boat had come adrift.

words.trans: 船舷上缘（常用复数 gunwales）。
examples: The waves crashed against the gunwales, sending spray into their faces.

words.trans: 在温暖的地方；引申处于安全、受保护或知情的状态。
examples: If only we had an eye in the sky, we'd be back in the warm in no time!

words.trans: 立刻、马上、很快（字面：用不了多少时间）。
examples: We'd be back in the warm in no time!

words.trans: 在巡逻、在执勤。
examples: It sounded like the security services were on patrol.

words.trans: 伸展、舒展；延伸、展开。
examples: He climbed until the southern half of the lake stretched out beyond the islands.

words.trans: n. 污迹、污点、模糊的痕迹。in moist charcoal smudges 呈潮湿木炭涂抹状（in + 形态名词，中文常处理成"化作、呈……模样"，如 Her hair fell in waves 头发呈波浪状垂落）。
examples: The rain clouds hung in moist charcoal smudges over Morecambe Bay.

words.trans: 饱和的、浸透的；（颜色）浓艳饱和的。
examples: The air was crisp and the lake and hills saturated with colour.

words.trans: 独自的、单独的；孤独的；唯一的、仅有的。
examples: A solitary yacht, its sails white in the sun, meandered downwind.

words.trans: v. 漫步、闲逛；（河流、道路等）蜿蜒曲折而行。n. 漫步；曲流、弯道。
examples: A solitary yacht meandered downwind.

words.trans: 沉浸于、陶醉于；迷失在……中。
examples: Normally Tom would have lost himself in the flight.

words.trans: 一次短暂的涉足/探路；一次快速的突袭（或探索）。
examples: A quick foray north took him to Brockbarrow.

words.trans: 少数、几个、少量。字面"一把"。
examples: The only sign of life was a handful of Swaledales dotted among the bracken.

words.trans: 腿部拉伸；腿部伸展动作。
examples: On Rigg Knott there was a lone runner doing some leg stretches.

words.trans: 除此之外；除了那一点之外。
examples: Apart from that the hilltop was empty.

words.trans: 卵石滩；砾石海滩（被水磨圆的扁卵石滩）。
examples: The dinghy was pulled up on the shingle beach.

words.trans: 和某人待在一起；和某人一起玩、闲逛。
examples: They wouldn't expect him to spend the summer holidays hanging out with them.

words.trans: 尽自己的一份力；尽本分。
examples: He would do his bit to keep Aunt Emily happy.

words.trans: 最不为人知的；知名度最低的。
examples: Benson Isle was the largest island but also the least known.

words.trans: （人）隐居避世的、不合群的。
examples: It had been owned by the same reclusive family since the eighteenth century.

words.trans: 踏上；涉足；进入（某地）。
examples: Even Jim Rothwell had never stepped foot on it.

words.trans: 说起来、这么一想、我突然想到。
examples: Come to think of it, I don't know anyone who has.

words.trans: 好奇的；爱打听的；好问的。
examples: In his many inquisitive flights over it, Tom had seen little sign of the owners.

words.trans: v. 停泊（船只）；n. 荒原、沼泽地。
examples: The Invincible was moored up under the Private: Keep Off sign.

words.trans: 隐秘的、僻静隐蔽的、与世隔绝的。
examples: He now owned its biggest and most secluded island.

words.trans: 自带"诱人"的感觉，主要形容食物/味道/感官体验非常甜美、多汁、浓郁。形容水果甜美多汁；味道浓郁醇厚；声音柔和悦耳、富有感染力。
examples: Luscious Lakeland - Real Ice Cream, Fresh from the Farm.

words.trans: （be up to sth）暗中谋划；在干（不明或不好的事）。
examples: Whatever he was up to, he clearly meant business.

words.trans: 动真格的；态度十分认真；决心要做成某事，不是玩玩而已。
examples: Whatever he was up to, he clearly meant business.

words.trans: 旅游船、观光汽艇。这里的 launch 不是"发射"，而是指"汽艇、游艇"（尤其小型机动船）。
examples: Most people, speeding by on a tourist launch, only glimpsed the round house.

words.trans: 附属配房、后院小屋。主楼之外独立的小房子（仓库、杂物间这类），不是主屋。
examples: She disappeared into a concrete outbuilding around the back.

words.trans: 在后面；绕到后面去。通常指建筑物、物体或某地的背面。
examples: She disappeared into a concrete outbuilding around the back.

words.trans: 废弃不用的（不再运营，但设备建筑还在）。
examples: The flight path took Tom over a disused slate quarry.

words.trans: 板岩采石场。
examples: The flight path took Tom over a disused slate quarry.

words.trans: 游隼（一种猛禽）。
examples: He had flown in to look at a nest of peregrine falcons.

words.trans: （鸟）栖息、停歇。
examples: The falcons were perched high up in the wall of rock.

words.trans: 满地散落板岩的。
examples: A vehicle was parked on the slate-strewn floor.

words.trans: 站岗；守卫；警戒。
examples: Standing guard at the entrance was ponytail man.

words.trans: 本义猛地一震、颠簸冲击（物理震动）；引申内心猛然一惊、心头一震、精神受到冲击。
examples: Tom felt a jolt as he realized it was a sub-machine gun.

words.trans: 冲锋枪。
examples: Tom felt a jolt as he realized it was a sub-machine gun.

words.trans: 【地形】地面陡降、向下倾斜；【抽象】逐渐疏远、脱离。
examples: Where the ground fell away into the woods, he saw straw-hat man.

words.trans: 写字板、夹板；（电脑）剪贴板。
examples: Straw-hat man stood there in a blazer and tie, with a clipboard in his hand.

words.trans: （烟雾、云朵、尘土）滚滚翻腾、汹涌翻涌，大片弥漫散开。
examples: Two Land Rovers followed with clouds of dust billowing behind.

words.trans: 习语：全套配备、加装了（设备）。
examples: Two black Land Rovers kitted out with spotlights and snorkels.

words.trans: 殿后，走在队伍的最后面。
examples: One Land Rover came at the front, one bringing up the rear.

words.trans: （人潜水用的）呼吸管（浮潜咬在嘴里、伸出水面呼吸）；汽车涉水喉。
examples: Two Land Rovers kitted out with spotlights and snorkels.

words.trans: 一小支（船）队；一群（船）。
examples: The Teal made her way through a flotilla of red and blue dinghies.

words.trans: 闲站着（扎堆聊天）。
examples: They stood around talking for a few more minutes.

words.trans: 一缕、一丝、薄薄一小股。专门形容轻薄、细长、飘散的东西（烟、云、尘）。
examples: Tom watched the wisps of dust disperse.

words.trans: 分散；散开；驱散。强调从聚集状态向四周散开。
examples: Tom watched the wisps of dust disperse.

words.trans: 不远万里、跨越千山万水、漂洋过海远道而来。
examples: He knew that tourists crossed the world to see sights like this.

words.trans: 直觉告诉他、有某种预感、心里隐隐觉得。
examples: But something told him these people were not there to enjoy the scenery.

words.trans: 名胜、景点。表名胜常用复数 sights。
examples: Tourists crossed the world to see sights like this.

words.trans: 风景、景色。通常指一个地区整体的自然风光，是不可数名词。
examples: These people were not there to enjoy the scenery.
